analysis_narrative:
Incumbent indifference is moderate. The three relevant incumbents — QuickBooks, Ramp, Brex — are all technically capable of building this feature but have not done so. The de facto under-service for 3+ years suggests the niche is not on their immediate roadmap.

The reason incumbents haven't prioritized this is likely competitive: Ramp and Brex don't want to make it easy to reconcile against competitor processors; QuickBooks is focused on accountants, not finance operators. This creates an accidental moat — not structural protection, but a window of inattention.

Score 3 reflects that incumbents are indifferent today but not structurally prevented from entering. A single feature prioritization decision by any of the three incumbents could change the competitive landscape quickly.
key_finding: Incumbents have de facto ignored this niche for 3+ years, creating a window of opportunity — but none are structurally prevented from entering.
score_explanation: Score 3 reflects de facto incumbent indifference rather than structural impossibility. The opportunity window is real but fragile — incumbents could address this with a feature sprint if motivated.
